title: At the Doctor's Office
subtitle: Describing basic symptoms — for English learners

sentences.en: Hello, what brings you in today?
sentences.target: Hello, what brings you in today?

sentences.en: I haven't been feeling well for the past three days.
sentences.target: I haven't been feeling well for the past three days.

sentences.en: Can you describe your symptoms for me?
sentences.target: Can you describe your symptoms for me?

sentences.en: I have a sore throat, a headache, and a small fever.
sentences.target: I have a sore throat, a headache, and a small fever.

sentences.en: Are you coughing or having any trouble breathing?
sentences.target: Are you coughing or having any trouble breathing?

sentences.en: I cough a little, especially at night.
sentences.target: I cough a little, especially at night.

sentences.en: Let me check your throat and listen to your lungs.
sentences.target: Let me check your throat and listen to your lungs.

sentences.en: It looks like a common cold. Drink lots of water and rest.
sentences.target: It looks like a common cold. Drink lots of water and rest.

sentences.en: If you don't feel better in a week, please come back.
sentences.target: If you don't feel better in a week, please come back.

sentences.en: Thank you, doctor. I'll do that.
sentences.target: Thank you, doctor. I'll do that.
